Article Title: Kolkata yoga instructor killed over PUBG romance: Cops
Article Text:
Dharambir Kumar has been arrested in connection with the murder of Anjali Shaw, a yoga instructor.

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines





KOLKATA: In the Dunlop yoga instructor Anjali Shaw (26) murder case, police suspect that Dharambir Kumar, the arrested online gaming partner of the victim, had plotted the crime after his relationship with her turned bitter over another woman.Meanwhile, Kumar was brought to Kolkata on Friday (Nov 13) on transit remand granted by a court in Delhi’s Anand Vihar. Deputy commissioner of police, Kuntal Bandyopadhyay, said Kumar was being interrogated.Kumar was arrested outside east Delhi’s Anand Vihar Terminal railway station on Thursday (Nov 12), about two days after Shaw’s body was recovered from her relative’s vacant flat in Baranagar.In his 30s, the accused—a resident of Hazratganj in Lucknow—had developed a relationship with Shaw while playing PUBG, an online game. Trouble allegedly began after Kumar started playing with another woman in a separate gaming group. Police suspect this led to a fallout and the accused planned the murder. Cops said Kumar had arrived in the city on Sunday (Nov 8) afternoon. He had allegedly checked into a guest house in Dakshineswar.On Tuesday (Nov 10) afternoon, Shaw had gone to her sister and brother-in-law’s flat at Shitala Mata Lane in Baranagar, allegedly on Kumar’s insistence.Police said Kumar entered the flat around 1.30 pm, allegedly killed Anjali, locked the flat from outside and left with her mobile phone and valuables. He returned to the guest house and later boarded Vibhuti Express from Howrah station for travelling to Delhi around 1.40 am.During the journey, he allegedly used Shaw’s phone to send messages to her family members to create an impression that she was alive. Police said he had used the phone till Mughalsarai, then switched it off and activated his own handset. Police doubt he repeatedly switched phones on and off and changed locations. Shaw’s father told police that Kumar was known to the family and that he used to address her as his sister.He also identified a PUBG player named “Nick Rajput,” possibly an account of Kumar. Probe is on to ascertain if others are involved.
Article Summary: Dharambir Kumar was arrested outside east Delhi’s Anand Vihar Terminal railway station on Thursday. Anjali Shaw's body was recovered from her relative's vacant flat in Baranagar. Kumar was brought to Kolkata on Friday (Nov 13) on transit remand.

Article Title: 'WhatsApp video call still active': Class 12 boy dies by suicide during video call with girlfriend; girl also kills herself
Article Text:
18-year-old students Jeet Biswas and Puja Mondal took their lives while connected via video call.

Were in class 12 at same school

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines





KOLKATA: An 18-year-old boy allegedly died by suicide while speaking to his girlfriend on a video call, following which the girl, too, allegedly took her own life.The two youngsters, Jeet Biswas and Puja Mondal, both around 18 and students of class 12 at Sendanga Chaturdaspalli High School, lived in the same neighbourhood in Ashoknagar, North 24 Parganas, and attended the same tuition classes. While neighbours said opposition to their relationship from family members could have led to the two taking the extreme step, the girl’s family claimed they learnt about her relationship with the boy only after the deaths.Police said Jeet was on a video call to Puja when he hanged himself from the ceiling. On watching him end his life, Puja, too, hanged herself from the ceiling, police said. It was when Puja’s family members did not receive any response from inside despite repeatedly calling her that they broke open the door to find her hanging. “The WhatsApp video call was still active on her mobile and on the screen, we saw the boy hanging. That was when we realised that the boy Puja was in love with had also died by suicide,” said Dipu, Puja’s elder brother.“A team from the Ashoknagar PS arrived at the spot and took the bodies of the two teenagers from their houses to hospital,” a senior Barasat District Police officer said.The youngsters’ classmates said the two had been in a relationship for several years.“They studied at the same school, attended tuition classes together and regularly travelled together,” a classmate said. A friend of Puja said, “ I had heard Jeet’s family was against their relationship but I cannot say if they were stressed over it. Everything appeared normal from outside.”But Puja’s mother, Phullareswari, claimed she had no inkling of her daughter’s relationship with Jeet. “My daughter would have appeared for her HS exams. When marriage was discussed, she would say she wanted to complete her studies first. We would not have objected to her marrying a boy of her choice. I cannot understand why she took such a step,” Phullareswari said. Dipu added that it was completely unexpected as Puja had been rather cheerful and had single-handedly organised bhaipota.Jeet’s family members declined to comment.The bodies were sent for a post-mortem at Barasat Medical College and Hospital on Friday. “We have registered separate cases of unnatural death,” an officer added.
Article Summary: Jeet Biswas and Puja Mondal, both around 18, were students of class 12 at Sendanga Chaturdaspalli High School. Police said Jeet was on a video call to Puja when he hanged himself from the ceiling. On watching him end his life, Puja, too, hanged herself, police said.

Article Title: 'Coaching Sanchalak Rapist': Agra man kills teacher over affair suspicion, writes message to mislead police
Article Text:
In photos: The deceased 50-year-old mathematics teacher, 22-year-old shoe manufacturer accused and white board, he wrote, "OP Yadav Rapist" to misguide the police

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines





AGRA: A 22-year-old shoe manufacturer was arrested in Uttar Pradesh's Agra district on Friday for allegedly stabbing a 50-year-old mathematics teacher to death over suspicions that the victim was having an affair with his girlfriend.After the murder, the accused allegedly wrote the words 'Coaching Sanchalak Rapist' in English on a whiteboard inside the coaching centre using a marker, in an attempt to mislead the police.According to the police, Nikhil Kumar, a resident of Shahganj who is involved in his family's shoe manufacturing business, was arrested by a team from Jagdishpura police station, led by SHO Ajay Kumar, during the intervening night of November 12 and 13.The police also recovered the scooter belonging to the deceased, Om Prakash Yadav alias OP, a native of Kanpur Dehat. Yadav taught at a private school and also ran a coaching institute in the Awas Vikas area, under the jurisdiction of Jagdishpura police station.Yadav was found dead inside his coaching centre after locals alerted the police about a foul smell emanating from the premises.A police team reached the spot and sent the body for post-mortem examination.The report revealed nine injuries on the victim's body, seven of which had been inflicted with a sharp-edged weapon. The deceased's mobile phone and scooter were also found missing from the spot, police said.An FIR was registered under Sections 103(1) (murder) and 238 (causing disappearance of evidence) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), and an investigation was launched.During interrogation, Nikhil told the police that he was in a relationship with a 20-year-old woman who had earlier attended coaching classes run by Yadav.ADCP Manoj Yadav told TOI that the accused had overheard his girlfriend speaking to the teacher over the phone. A few days later, he also saw the two having pizza at a restaurant, which led him to suspect that Yadav was in a relationship with her."On November 2, 2026, at around 6 pm, the accused reached the coaching centre and waited outside for the students to leave. After all the students had left, he entered the centre. The accused had brought a bag from home containing a large iron butcher's knife used for cutting meat, along with another shirt and a pair of trousers. The coaching centre owner was sitting on his chair. On seeing the accused, he became angry, picked up a lock lying on the table and attempted to hit the accused on the head.The accused then took out the knife from his bag and attempted to strike the coaching centre owner on the neck. However, the knife struck his face and hand. While trying to defend himself, the coaching centre owner suddenly lost his balance, hit a bench and fell face down on the floor. The accused climbed onto his back and struck his neck with the knife, severing it," Yadav told TOI.Nikhil allegedly fled from the coaching centre with the owner's mobile phone, scooter keys and helmet."The accused then wrote the words 'Coaching Sanchalak Rapist' in English with a marker on the whiteboard installed inside the coaching centre, to misguide the police. The teams examined around 400 CCTV cameras. During the night of November 12-13, 2026, acting on information received from an informer, the police team arrested Nikhil from Agra. On his identification, the police recovered the murder weapon (one knife), the deceased's scooter and helmet, and the accused's bloodstained shirt. Further probe is on," Yadav further said.
Article Summary: Om Prakash Yadav, 50, was found dead inside his coaching centre after locals alerted the police about a foul smell emanating from the premises. Nikhil Kumar, a resident of Shahganj who is involved in his family's shoe manufacturing business, was arrested by a team from Jagdishpura police station. He told the police that he was in a relationship with a 20-year-old woman who had earlier attended coaching classes run by Yadav.

Article Title: 10-year relationship, 2 chemical packets: Twists and turns behind 3 deaths in 25 days in Delhi
Article Text:
(AI image) Three tragic deaths in Delhi are under investigation, linked by a long-standing relationship that began years ago

NEW DELHI: A relationship that reportedly began over phone calls nearly a decade ago, a husband’s death from suspected poisoning, and two more lives lost just weeks later — investigators are now piecing together the events connecting three deaths in Delhi.On Nov 11, police received a PCR call regarding an incident at Lal Farm in southwest Delhi’s Mohan Garden. “The caller informed cops that his mother and a man had allegedly consumed a poisonous substance and were locked inside a vehicle,” a police source said.A team from the local police station rushed to the spot, where they were met by the 18-year-old caller. Inside a parked white car, police found a 46-year-old man and a woman lying unconscious, alongside two unsealed packets of chemicals. Both were rushed to a nearby hospital, where doctors declared them unfit to give statements. Despite medical intervention, both died during treatment.During further inquiry, police learnt that the man had been working with Delhi Home Guards for around 15 years — reportedly on a temporary basis — and was currently posted in Jahangirpuri. He had known the woman for nearly a decade.“The man and the woman’s husband initially knew each other.Ten years ago, the husband had sent certain documents and messages to the man using his wife’s mobile phone. Subsequently, the man and the woman came into contact and began talking on the phone. Gradually, their acquaintance developed into a relationship,” the source said.Police also found that the woman’s husband had died on Oct 17 this year after allegedly consuming poison in Shahbad Dairy.A resident of Sultanpuri, the home guard is survived by his wife, a homemaker, and two sons. While the elder son works as a driver with Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD), the younger one has completed Class XII.The woman is survived by two sons. Her elder son worked as a driver in Gurgaon until leaving the job about a month ago, while her 15-year-old younger son is a Class X student at a school in Mohan Garden. Both children are currently staying with their paternal uncle and grandparents in Mohan Garden.Police are awaiting the post-mortem reports to ascertain the exact cause of death and are examining the deceased’s call records as part of the ongoing probe.

Article Title: Tagged by rivals as BJP’s B team, AIMIM yet to replicate Bihar poll play in UP
Article Text:
MP Asaduddin Owaisi’s All India Ittehadul Muslimeen (AIMIM) joined hands with Chandrashekhar Azad-led Azad Samaj Party

Timeline

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines





LUCKNOW: When firebrand Hyderabad MP Asaduddin Owaisi ’s All India Ittehadul Muslimeen ( AIMIM ) joined hands with Chandrashekhar Azad-led Azad Samaj Party – KanshI Ram (ASP – KR) to contest all 403 UP assembly seats in 2027 polls, the announcement created ripples but failed to trigger any fireworks in the political circles like it did when it entered the Bihar poll fray or the recently concluded West Bengal assembly elections.One reason for this meek entry was that Telangana-headquartered AIMIM has been trying its luck in UP state polls since 2017 UP assembly elections, but has failed to send a single MLA to the state’s Vidhan Sabha in a decade.This has been in sharp contrast to its impactful electoral journey in Bihar and of late even in Maharashtra and West Bengal.Political experts are of the view that more than AIMIM’s political rivals, it is the Muslim community in UP – the core voter base that Owaisi’s party focuses on – which does not see the party as a potential political challenger to national parties like the BJP or the more regionally focused outfits like the Samajwadi Party or the Bahujan Samaj Party for that matter.Lack of organisational machinery and absence of foot soldiers on ground have only compounded Owaisi’s challenges.This apart, another major challenge for the AIMIM in UP is that its political rivals have somewhat successfully managed to label Owaisi as the B team of BJP – a perception that has gained significant ground among Muslims.As a result, while the AIMIM-backed candidates have emerged victorious in local body polls where candidates’ personal relations at the hyper local level matter more than his political affiliations, the party has failed miserably to bag enough votes to put the party candidate in a fighting position.In 2025 Bihar polls, AIMIM contested 29 seats and retained the five that it had won in the Muslim dominated Seemanchal belt in 2020. In 2026 Maharashtra civic polls, Owaisi’s party bagged 114 seats, including 33 in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar.In UP, AIMIM started making its presence felt in the run-up to the 2017 assembly polls. The party came under the political spotlight in early 2016 after the then SP govt led by Akhilesh Yadav did not permit Owaisi to address rallies in Azamgarh – a stronghold of SP.Later, Owaisi claimed that he was stopped from visiting the state 12 times and permission to do his rallies were cancelled 28 times in the 12 months before the 2017 polls.The party, however, went on to contest 38 seats in the Assembly polls securing 2,04,142 votes (0.24% of the vote share) without winning a seat.In the 2022 assembly polls, AIMIM contested 96 seats to bag 0.43% vote share. A major political upheaval erupted when it was alleged that AIMIM candidates on many seats secured votes more than BJP’s victory margin.Social media posts then claimed that this happened on 165 seats and Owaisi himself came out in the media to claim that post was unfounded as the party had contested only 96 seats.The 2023 urban bodies elections in UP, however, came as a shot in the arm for the AIMIM with the party’s five chairpersons in the Nagar Palika Parishad and 75 councillors in the municipal corporation making it through.This was a massive increase of 126% in seats from 32 in the previous local body polls. AIMIM’s mayoral nominee in Meerut grabbed the second position, next to BJP.
Article Summary: Hyderabad MP Asaduddin Owaisi’s All India Ittehadul Muslimeen (AIMIM) joined hands with Chandrashekhar Azad-led Azad Samaj Party – KanshI Ram to contest all 403 UP assembly seats in 2027 polls.

Article Title: 'What difference does it make?': Molester asked Mumbai woman before pushing her off platform; how Naigaon horror unfolded inside local train
Article Text:
A 20-year-old woman confronted a 53-year-old man for alleged molestation inside a Mumbai local train.

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines





VASAI: “What difference does it make?” was the response a 53-year-old man allegedly gave a 20-year-old woman when she confronted him for molesting her inside a Mumbai local train The exchange soon escalated into a physical altercation at Naigaon station, where the man allegedly pushed her onto the tracks. As she tried to climb back onto the platform, the train began moving, crushing her left arm below the elbow.The woman, who got married just five months ago, had gone to Malad on November 4 to buy a phone. With trains packed, she travelled to Borivli and boarded a Virar-bound slow local. She mistakenly entered the compartment reserved for persons with disabilities.According to her complaint, a man later identified as Jitendra Hirmukhe (53) repeatedly pushed against her inside the crowded compartment. Initially, she ignored him, but when the train reached Bhayander, he allegedly began touching her inappropriately.Both got off at Naigaon station around 7.15pm, where the woman confronted Hirmukhe. Instead of backing off, he allegedly touched her inappropriately again and asked her, “What difference does it make?”Angered by his response, the woman took off her slipper and threw it at him. Hirmukhe allegedly abused her, removed his own slipper and hit her with it.The train was still standing at the platform, and several passengers gathered as the confrontation escalated. Hirmukhe allegedly pushed the woman, causing her to fall onto the tracks into the gap between two coaches.As she tried to climb back onto the platform, the train started moving. She fell into the platform gap, and her left arm came under the train's wheels. The arm was severed below the elbow.Hirmukhe fled the spot. The woman was initially taken to a hospital in Vasai and later shifted to a Mumbai hospital for further treatment. She is undergoing treatment at a civic hospital.Bhayander railway police examined CCTV footage from the station and traced Hirmukhe to his residence in Wakipada, Naigaon East. He was arrested on November 9, five days after the incident. He originally hails from Dharashiv district.“He has stomach cancer and was travelling in the compartment reserved for persons with disabilities. We traced him with the help of CCTV footage and arrested him from Naigaon,” said Ganpat Tumbada, senior inspector, Bhayander railway police.Police initially registered a case under sections 74 ( molestation ), 117(2) (voluntarily causing hurt) and 352 (intentional insult) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita. Section 109 (attempt to murder) was subsequently added. Hirmukhe is in judicial custody.The woman has demanded the strictest punishment for the accused. “Despite having done nothing wrong, I had to go through this ordeal. I have permanently lost one of my arms... I want justice,” she said in her statement.
Article Summary: Jitendra Hirmukhe, 53, allegedly molested a 20-year-old woman inside a Mumbai local train. The exchange soon escalated into a physical altercation at Naigaon station, where the man allegedly pushed her onto the tracks. As she tried to climb back onto the platform, the train began moving, crushing her left arm below the elbow. The woman was initially taken to a hospital in Vasai and later shifted to a Mumbai hospital.

Article Title: CEO of world's largest AI models repository, Hugging Face, calls Jensen Huang's resignation as Nvidia CEO 'sad'; says: I want to make one thing clear that we will keep fighting for ...
Article Text:
He’s no longer Nvidia’s CEO, so does Jensen Huang still have to face Congress on November 18?

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Hugging Face CEO Clement Delangue expressed dismay following the departure of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, moving quickly to reassure the open-source artificial intelligence community that his company’s mission remains unchanged ahead of its pending multibillion-dollar acquisition by the chipmaker. For those unaware, Hugging Face is the world's biggest repository for AI models.In a post on the social platform X, formerly Twitter, Delangue called the leadership change at Nvidia a “really sad day” while vowing to maintain momentum for open-source development. He wrote, “This whole thing sucks, and I wish none of it had happened. It’s a really sad day! But I want to make one thing clear: we’ll keep fighting for open-source AI, harder than ever. This is too important to slow down now. Let’s go!”Delangue’s remarks are seen as the worry among open-source advocates regarding Nvidia’s future commitment to the ecosystem without Huang at the helm. In September, Nvidia announced plans to acquire Hugging Face -- a central hub for open-source AI models -- for $12.9 billion. The transaction represents the second-largest acquisition in Nvidia’s history, trailing only its $20 billion purchase of chipmaker Groq’s assets in December 2025.The acquisition, which remains scheduled to close in the first half of 2027, has already drawn regulatory scrutiny. In October, Reuters reported that the U.S.Department of Justice had begun inquiring into how the merger might affect competition in the AI sector. Although Nvidia pledged to maintain Hugging Face’s open support, critics and regulators have noted that the deal would give the hardware giant control over a primary distribution channel for AI models.Under Huang’s leadership, Nvidia had positioned itself as a vocal champion of open-source and open-weight models—systems whose underlying parameters are publicly accessible. During his keynote address at the Consumer Electronics Show in Las Vegas in January this year, Huang remarked that open-source models had “really revolutionized artificial intelligence.”In July, Huang used his first-ever post on X to publish an AI policy letter signed by 25 technology companies, including Microsoft, Meta, IBM, Palantir, and Hugging Face. The letter urged the U.S. government to avoid over-regulating open-weight models, arguing that software anyone can “download, inspect, modify, and run on their own infrastructure” prevents vendor lock-in and makes AI more accessible.Huang wrote, "For my first post, I’m sharing a letter @NVIDIA signed on why open models matter. AI will transform every industry, power every company, and be built by every country. Open models strengthen safety and cybersecurity, accelerate innovation and diffusion, and enable sovereignty. The world needs both frontier closed models and frontier open models."
Article Summary: Hugging Face CEO Clement Delangue expressed dismay following the departure of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. In September, Nvidia announced plans to acquire Hugging Face -- a central hub for open-source AI models -- for $12.9 billion. The acquisition, which remains scheduled to close in the first half of 2027, has drawn regulatory scrutiny.

'Dream come true': Sooryavanshi on leading Bihar

NEW DELHI: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi had a memorable and amusing moment during his historic captaincy debut on Saturday when the 15-year-old forgot Bihar's playing XI after winning the toss against Saurashtra in their Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy (SMAT) 2026-27 opener at the Holkar Stadium.Asked about his team's combination after opting to bat, Sooryavanshi responded with a smile: "I think, sir, bhool gaya lagta main (I think, sir, I have forgotten)."The light-hearted exchange quickly became a talking point on a landmark day for the teenage batting sensation, who became the youngest captain in men's T20 cricket history at 15 years and 232 days.Sooryavanshi broke the previous record held by Croatia's Zach Vukusic, who had captained his national side at 17 years and 311 days in a T20 International against Cyprus on August 7, 2025.The Bihar youngster described the opportunity to captain his home state as a special moment, expressing gratitude for being entrusted with the responsibility.“It feels like a dream come true because I started playing cricket here, and getting the opportunity to lead the same state is a big thing. I am very grateful, and I will try to fulfil the responsibility given to me to the best of my ability," he said.Bihar handed Sooryavanshi the leadership role for their first two matches of the domestic T20 competition.The appointment marks another milestone in his rapid rise, having made his India debut just five months ago. He was also named vice-captain of East Zone for the 2026-27 Duleep Trophy, deputising for Ishan Kishan.His first outing as Bihar captain, however, did not produce a substantial contribution with the bat. Sooryavanshi scored 18 off 12 deliveries before being caught and bowled by left-arm pacer Chetan Sakariya.Bihar managed 137/9 in their 20 overs, with Prithvi Raj top-scoring with 38. Saurashtra chased down the target in 16.3 overs to register a five-wicket victory. Harvansh Pangalia led the chase with 33 off just 11 balls, hitting three sixes and three fours.Sooryavanshi is expected to feature in only one more SMAT match before joining India A for the ACC Rising Stars Emerging tournament in Doha from November 19.His latest international outing came during India's T20I tour of New Zealand, where he scored 49 runs in two matches. His 19-ball 45, featuring in a 133-run opening stand with Abhishek Sharma in just 7.1 overs, was among the highlights of India's 3-2 series victory.
Article Summary: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi becomes youngest captain in men's T20 cricket history. The 15-year-old forgot Bihar's playing XI after winning the toss against Saurashtra. Bihar managed 137/9 in their 20 overs, with Prithvi Raj top-scoring with 38.

Article Title: Theatre review: When the pursuit of greatness turns destructive
Article Text:
A still from the play

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

-- Anvita Singh

Want us to review your play? Mail us at tims.delhitimes@timesofindia.com





Vivek Mehra is an ambitious architect, blinded by his own passions and achievements. The scene opens in his office, where he is presumably having an affair with his trusted young secretary, Kavya. Vivek wants to keep both Kavya and her partner Aarav in his firm, not necessarily because they are his proteges or because he is emotionally attached to either of them. It is purely need-based; Aarav is a fine young designer and Vivek doesn't want him to leave and start his own company.Sunil Kumar, who plays Vivek, largely succeeds in making the audience intrigued by his desires for fame and money, while dividing them over his obviously questionable choices. These include his decision to cheat on his depressed wife, who still seems to be mourning their shared burnt-down house, her twins and all her memories and expectations attached to that building. Vivek, like his wife, is also undergoing psychological treatment as he frequently refers to himself as a madman.Vivek Mehra is a liar, a cheat, a genius. He also happens to be a man who sexually abused a 12-year-old who returns a decade later seeking revenge.Kumar plays these layers convincingly enough. However, at times it does feel as though one is watching a well-made 1990s soap opera, rather than a rooted play about morality, ambitions and human greed.The play's most compelling moments arrive when Vivek's truth comes to the surface during a confrontation with Hina (ably played by actor Swati), the young woman who had been sexually abused by him. His admission that he knowingly allowed his home to burn down despite sensing that something was wrong, gives the story a much-needed jolt.It also exposes the disturbing lengths to which he has gone to preserve his image as a master builder.The loud, slightly melodramatic background music interferes with the momentum of the play. However, the buildup to the final sequence, as Vivek scales a new building despite his vertigo, to prove that he can rise above his fears, brings the play to a fitting conclusion.The production's use of both the props and the stage to depict Vivek's attempt to reach the top of the building, the chaos that suddenly surrounds him as people tried to dissuade him, and the moment when he falters and falls ties a neat ribbon around the narrative.
Article Summary: Vivek Mehra is an ambitious architect blinded by his own passions and achievements. Sunil Kumar, who plays Vivek, largely succeeds in making the audience intrigued by his desires for fame and money. The production's use of both the props and the stage depict Vivek's attempt to reach the top of the building.
